nativeAdaptations: The shared native dashboard exposes the source account/profile link and the UsersAdmin resource link. Profile display, avatar and logout live in the native Account screen.
Administrative destinations use server capabilities and authoritative canManageUsers. Mapping this URL does not grant panel access or infer privileges from a native role string.

excludedImplementationDetails.reason: Framework branding, installed package version and external framework documentation/source links describe the web implementation. They are intentionally excluded from the native product.

authRequirements: Password verification accepts only an existing non-banned, non-deleted superadmin through the actual panel canAccessPanel policy. There is no password signup or ordinary-user password login.

The native password endpoint shares Filament's five-attempt IP lockout before form validation, generic credential failures and configured password rehash policy. A future required or enabled MFA challenge refuses password-only token issuance.
Google sign-in remains a separate existing source path. Both native methods adopt the same mobile-only Sanctum session through the verified account provider.
verificationLimits: Password transport and native form are implemented and tested locally. No real production credential request or production sign-in success has been claimed.
Backend rollout and local native sign-in flow verification remain separate required work.

gaps.description: Component exports do not prove deep-link reachability. Root is porting canonical website paths/query preservation into the native router, including public and private aliases.
Stateless native admin aliases and strict JSON acknowledgements are implemented/tested locally only. Existing production browser middleware is not proof of working native writes.
Real Google native authentication and privileged flow verification require the configured iOS OAuth project and test account. No production political writes were made.

authRequirements: Same actual superadmin and not-banned panel access rule. Native options/Dashboard canManageUsers is authoritative, with first-party-only trusted mobile or browser session transport.
UserPermissionForm is the extracted unchanged source split/merge implementation; unknown existing capabilities and other module scopes survive updates.
Fresh actor authorization and row-version checking occur inside transactions. Source-permitted self-demotion/deletion remain allowed with native confirmations; existing ban refusals remain.
features: Panel dashboard account/profile/logout and UserResource navigation use the shared native Dashboard and Account screens; framework information is explicitly excluded in filamentRoutes
Filament password login and the separate source Google sign-in path use native Account, with their exact transports recorded in filamentRoutes

tests: Existing CapabilitiesTest, TransitGovernorateScopeTest and UserBanCapabilityTest pass after helper extraction.
Independent backend/native source reviews and rendered selection/permission regressions passed. Actual native form/privilege/destructive-flow verification and backend rollout remain required.
